description: Source code for gain adaptation in AMR speech codec, including functions for initializing, resetting, exiting, and computing gain adaptation factors, with references to 3GPP standards.

methods.name: gain_adapt_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the GainAdaptState structure.

methods.name: gain_adapt_reset
methods.description: Resets the GainAdaptState structure to initial values.

methods.name: gain_adapt_exit
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for GainAdaptState.

methods.name: gain_adapt
methods.description: Calculates the gain adaptation factor based on LTP gain and code gain, updating the state.
